title: Dungeons and Taverns
description: A Structure Datapack adding dungeons, taverns and other structures to find while you explore the world.
author: NovaWostra
body:
This datapacks adds (hopefully) vanilla like structures that are supposed to blend in with the rest of the game and feel like they belong there. going from environmental additions like fire watch towers and taverns to dungeons like badland minder outpost and illager hideout

### **WARNING: It has been discovered recently that someone(s) made a malicious website claiming to be the official website for Dungeons and Taverns, when in actuality it host malware!!!**
The **_ONLY_** official places for all things Dungeons and Taverns are the [Modrinth page of the creator](https://modrinth.com/user/NovaWostra), the [Curseforge page of the creator](https://www.curseforge.com/members/nova_wostra/projects), and the [Witches Cauldron Discord Server](https://discord.com/invite/fPvvmcnKza).

**To unlock maps at a tavern, you need to trade with the cateographer inside a tavern and level them up to aprentice. after that you can "move" them to wherever you want and keep leveling them up to unlock new charts**

**To remove Structures you dont like, go to "Dnt/data/nova_structures/worldgen/structure_set/" and delete the file of the structure you dont want.**

**To see the custom key textures, while using the datapack version, Install DnT also as a resourcepack. It's a 2 in one file
The Mod version loads those resources automatically
**

Various new enchantments can be found with this datapack, all being unique structure loot. This is the current information for 5.0+, as such it may not be accurate to prior versions of DnT.

List of enchantments:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Aerial's Bane
- Increased damage to targets that are up in the air; be that from knockback, jumping, or falling. Also works against Breezes, Vexes, and Withers.
- Items: Swords, Axes, Tridents, Maces, Bows, Crossbows
- Max level: 5
- Incompatible with: Damage boosting enchants like Sharpness and Power
- Found in: Lone Citadel, Sealing Halls, End Castle

Antidote
- Negates all damage from Poison and Wither effects and deals it to the chestplate.
- Items: Chestplates
- Max level: 1
- Incompatible with: Protection enchantments
- Found in: Toxic Lair

Blowthrough
- Is equal to the Piercing enchant, but works exclsuviely for Bows
- Items: Bows
- Max level: 4
- Incompatible with: Infinity, Tri-shot
- Found in: Toxic Lair

Curse of Conductivity
- Gives a chance to get struck by lightning during a thunderstorm when held or equipped
- Items: Any "metallic" item :)
- Max level: 1
- Incompatible with: N/A
- Found in: Witch Villa

Ghasted
- Arrows transform into Ghast fireballs, while slowing crossbow charge time. Higher levels increase fireballs' explosions.
- Items: Crossbow
- Max level: 3
- Incompatible with: Multishot, Piercing, Might, Aerial's Bane
- Found in: Sealing Halls

Gravity
- Shoot an arrow which pulls all mobs around it upon landing, destroying the arrow in the process
- Items: Crossbow
- Max level: 
- Incompatible with: N/A
- Found in: End Castle

Hydro Veil
- Increases Happy Ghast healing to match rain / cloud layer healing, except when in the Nether. Also takes less damage from fire and explosions per level.
- Items: Harnesses
- Max level: 4
- Incompatible with: N/A
- Found in: Nether Keep, Sealing Halls

Illager's Bane
- Increased damage against illagers, ravgers, vexes, and witches.
- Items: Swords, Axes, Tridents, Maces
- Max level: 5
- Incompatible with: Damage enchants like Sharpness
- Found in: Illager Manor, Illager Hideout

Outreach
- Increases block interaction range per level, allowing you to place or break blocks from farther.
- Items: Chestplate
- Max level: 4
- Incompatible with: N/A
- Found in: Desert Ruins

Photosynthesis
- Restores the item's durability while the user is under sunlight from the sky or in block light that can grow crops.
- Items: Any with durability
- Max level: 1
- Incompatible with: Mending
- Found in: Jungle Ruins

Might
- Boosts the arrows damage equal to Power enchantment, but applicable to Crossbows.
- Items: Crossbow
- Max level: 5
- Incompatible with: Gravity, Ghasted, Piercing, Multishot
- Found in: Lone Citadel

Spiteful
- Users with 2.5 hearts or less are given a attack damage boost per enchant level. If hit by a mob at any health there's a small chance to receive Strength.
- Items: Swords, Axes, Tridents, Maces
- Max level: 3
- Incompatible with: N/A
- Found in: Pale Residence, certain Shrines...

Swift Soar
- Boosts the Happy Ghast's flying speed while the rider is considered sprinting.
- Items: Harnesses
- Max level: 3
- Incompatible with: N/A
- Found in: Nether Port, Nether Keep, Sealing Halls

Traveler
- Boosts movement speed and step height while sprinting. Slowly drains durability while doing so.
- Items: Boots
- Max level: 3
- Incompatible with: Soul Speed
- Found in: Shrines, random graves found in DnT structures

Tri-shot
- Is equal to Multishot in effect, but applicable to Bows
- Items: Bows
- Max level: 1
- Incompatible with: Infinity, Piercing, Multishot
- Found in: Toxic Lair

Wax Wings
- Negates elytra damage from slow gliding, but raises durability drain from firework boosting.
- Items: Elytra
- Max level: 1
- Incompatible with: Unbreaking
- Found in: End Castle

Wither Coated
- Inflicts Wither effect to direct hit foes. Higher levels boost potency but lowers duration. In practice, this causes the same amount of Wither damage but faster with higher levels.
- Each attack also reduces item durability by 1.
- Items: Swords, Axes, Tridents, Maces
- Max level: 3
- Incompatible with: Fire Aspect
- Found in: Nether Port, Sealing Halls



</details>


Secret Librarian Trades 

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

With this datapack, certain DnT structures will award a librarian villager with an exclusive trade if they're leveled up from novice to apprentice while inside certain structures, thus allowing many enchantments to be renewable. Can only get one enchantment at a time. The potential structures are listed below.
- Desert Ruins: Outreach
- End Castle: Aerial's Bane, Gravity, Wax Wings
- Illager Hideout: Illager's Bane
- Illager Manor: Illager's Bane
- Jungle Ruins: Photosynthesis
- Nether Keep: Hydro Veil, Swift Soar, Wither Coated
- Nether Port: Swift Soar
- Pale Residence: Spiteful
- Piglin Donjon: Soul Speed
- Sealing Halls: Aerial's Bane, Ghasted, Hydro Veil, Swift Soar, Wither Coated
- Lone Citadel: Wind Burst, Aerial's Bane, Might
- Toxic Lair: Antidote, Blowthrough, Tri-shot
- Shrines: Traveler
- Shrine Tower: Traveler
- Bunker: Traveler
- Undead Crypt: Traveler
- Witch Villa: Curse of Conductivity
- Ancient City (requires the DnT Ancient City Overhaul): Swift Sneak

</details>



If you dont Want those enchantments, use this datapack:
[[https://modrinth.com/datapack/nofun-dnt](https://modrinth.com/datapack/nofun-dnt)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/dnt-enchant-disabler)

the current structure list is:
[See Here](https://modrinth.com/datapack/dungeons-and-taverns/gallery)

if you have trouble to find dungeons, type "/locate structure nova_structures:[then a list of structure names should be prompted for autofill]"

versions.name: Dungeons and Taverns 6.0.1
versions.changelog:
# Dungeons and Taverns 6.0.1 Hotfix
- Fixed ALL loot tables / predicates / villager trades having erroneous number formats, causing them to act inconsistently.
- Fixed a ton of structure jigsaw formats; i.e. restoring some structure complexity variety that was erroneously missing.
- Fixed the chests/barrels in the basement of the Dappled Townhall being erroneously empty.
- Fixed tavern traders being unable to offer Charts to other taverns due to erroneous predicates.
- Fixed some Tavern Charts having the wrong rarity for their villager level. 
- Fixed the Ghast miniboss being unable to spawn their ghast children.
- Fixed the Ghast miniboss not dropping a Tears music disc in any context. (was added to be a 25% chance per Looting)
- Removed a now unused tick command; this should help with frame rate for users with older setups.
- Fixed A Major Trial of Strength advancement having it's icon changed erroneously.
- Fixed a structure piece for the Mangrove Well being misspelled.
- Removed a now unused template file that was accidentally being called upon still.

versions.name: Dungeons and Taverns 6
versions.changelog:
# Dungeons and Taverns v6.0 #
 this update was suposed to be focused around adding smaller structures to DnT as well as some dappled forest additions but escalated through the many changes in 26.3 into a little overhaul on how charts are accesed, and the tavern trade system, with some smaller overworld structures leading to bigger structures. This means that trading with catographers should be more friendly, but also avoidable if you just go out and explore

Due to the changes of 26.3 old maps and charts from prior versions, if you update for an existing world, will look a bit wonky.

## Additions ##
 - Added The Dappled Village
 - Added The Dappled Townhall as a rarer, overrun version of the Village (1/20 chance to replace)
 - Added Dappled Firewatch Towers
 - Added Dappled Tavern
 - Added Mini Creeping Crypts which spawn in forest biomes, containing sometimes a chart to a proper Creeping Crypt
  - Added a Mini Undead Crypt, also spawning in forests, containing sometimes a chart to a proper Undead Crypt
 - Overhauled Wells to be an entirely new structure 3/4 times: 
   - 1/4 chance to spawn the suspicious Gravel as before
   - 1/4 chance to spawn a little cave chamber at the bottom of the well
  - 1/4 chance to spawn a dungeon at the bottom of the well
   - 1/4 chance to spawn water with a treasure chest at the bottom of the well
   - Added new well variants :)
   - Added 2 new well advancements :)
 - Added Illager Treehouses
   - Illager Treehouses are a varaint of Illager Camps that have a 1/5 chance to replace them, featuring a 3x3 dark oak tree with some platforms instead of a campfire
 - Finally Introduced the Parched, Bogged and Stray camps in generation
   - Stray camps have a Bogged Camp, Stray Outlook, Snowy Village charts
   - Parched camps have a Stray Camp, Desert Temple, Desert Ruins or Desert Village Chart
   - Bogged camps have a Parched Camp, Swamp Village, Toxic Lair or Witch Village Chart
 - Added 4 types of surface Dungeons:
   - normal, spawns in any biome
   - desert, spawns in deserts
   - swamp, spawns in swamps
   - snowy, spawns in snowy biomes
   - each surface dungeon has a 1/5 chance to spawn as a skull version instead
   - each surface dungeon has a 1/10 chance to spawn a normal spawner instead of a trail spawner
 - Small Surface Dungeons, Small Crypts and the 3 Overworld Skeleton Camps share all 1 structure set, with 1 of them spawning every 40x40 chunk area with at least 16 chunks inbetween
 - Added 2 New Remnants
 - Added a new structure set called "common remnants" which contains only classic village remnants and miner hut remnants (1/10 times the classic village remnant spawns)
   - this was done so those 2 remnants apear more commonly. spawning 1 instance every 80x80 chunks with at least 30 chunks between 2 instances and avoiding villages by 10 chunks
 - Added Nether Skeleton camps, which generate like piglin camps, but just with nether skeletons, replacing nether skeleton towers 66% of the time
 - Added 2 Smaller Conduit ruins, for cold and warm. they are just the conduit
 - Proper Conduit ruins became larger as consiquence, but also rarer
## Changes ##
 - DnT Villages now spawn rarer (1 village in a 51x51 chunk area with at least 16 chunks inbetween)
 - Updated As Many Places that where suposed to be sitting spots as we could remember, with cushions
 - Updated some places with Wool Stairs
 - Updated Illagers Camps with new wool stairs, cushions and straw beds
 - Increased Spawnrate for Firewatch Towers:
   - 1 structure every 38x38 chunks with 8 chunks min inbetween
 - Increased Sizes of Undead Crypts
 - Illager Camp Structure Placement changed:
   - Avoids villages by 1 chunk
   - 1 Camp or Treehouse spawns within 36x36 chunks with at least 12 chunks inbetween
 - Illager Camps no longer have charts in their chest, but instead some gold and iron or emeralds
 - Illager Camps now have Camp Captains which have x3 the amound of HP of a normal Pillager, these now drop charts you usualy would ha

versions.name: Dungeons and Taverns 5.3.0
versions.changelog:
# Dungeons and Taverns v5.3.0 #
 - Updated pack to 26.2, duh
 - Updated Creeping Crypt:
   - Most of the gravel filled rooms have been cleaned up
   - Same with the hallways
   - the floor can now have suspicious gravel and gravel additionally to the cobblestone, coarse dirt and mossy cobblestone
    - added a few new rooms, some directly taken over as best as i can from Minecraft Dungeons Creeping Crypt
   - Spawn now 1 in a 50x50 chunks radius with at least 25 chunks between 2 instances instead of 55x55 separated by 30
    - added another Crypt Entry House variant
    - added 2 new Crypt Entry Halls variants
    - deadends now lead to a small room with 1-4 grave chests, like in minecraft dungeons. unless it cant generate those, then it just uses the old fallback piece
    - vaults and trial spawner have been moved around to be in more deliberate places that make more sense than in a random corner
   - Stair rooms have been removed, rebuild and re-added
   - most candles aren't lit anymore to not prevent natural mob spawning
   - Creeping Crypt Keys rate has been reduced from trial spawners (before 3/5, now 1/6)
   - Spider amount from trial spawner has been increased
   - loot tables for vaults, graves and hallway chests have been rewritten
   - some chests are trapped now :)
  - New Structure has been added: Creeper Homestead Remnant.
   - It's a remnant so dont expect to find it.
   - It's only located in badlands, I tried my best to spawn it only above sulfur caves but that lead to most of them spawning in oceans...
   - it spawns creepers like pillager outpost spawns pillagers
 - Updated The Pale Residence
   - in an attempt to fix MC-308792 before I could properly diagnose what it was, I assumed that the mossy features where causing the issue, so I removed those features and manually placed all leafblocks and moss carpets instead
   - due to MC-308792 creaking hearts aren't guaranteed anymore by a capped amount but instead set with a template pool, you can set yourself how likely you want them, also no more grass or flowers inside.
 - Same Updates to the Pale Taverns as to the Pale Residence
 - Updated Birch Village, Tavern and Firewatch Tower
   - the style has been changed of them to look like the Squid Coast Villages since the previous style was based of the Pumpkin Pastures Villages. their style will return in a **future update** when the Dappled Village will be added
 - Villages are rarer now, they all share now a structure set and spawn now 1 in a 51x51 chunks radius with at least 16 chunks between 2 instances instead of36x36 separated by 8
- Updated Conduit Ruins and Archeology Cave Chambers
   - Changed how suspicious sand/gravel generates. instead of capped processor it now uses a chance based processor due to MC-308792
   - this means as example: instead of 5 sand/gravel with generic loot and 1 sand/gravel with treasure its now 5% and 1%. not optimal but nothing i can fix about it. take that up with mojang

versions.name: Dungeons and Taverns 5.2.0
versions.changelog:
## Dungeons and Taverns v5.2.0 ##
  - Datadriven Trades allowed *some* changes to our special villager trade system
  - Secret Library traders now roll instead the trade for the structure specific enchantments as a first roll, however this is random due to the nature of datadriven trades.
  - Secret Librarian Trades now require an item from the structure to buy the book, usually a key or something of that nature to ensure you cant just easily skip interacting with the structure. you know who you are.
  - HOWEVER due to the randomness of what trades are selected, Tavern Traders haven't been changed.
- Updated Creeping Crypts
  - Creeping Crypts spawn now not anymore in Taigas but any forest biome
  - Creeping Crypts have been made smaller to compensate for its commonness
- Illager Camps can now roll for Illager Barracks (66% roll for Pillager Outpost, 33% for Illager Barracks)
- Added New Structure: Illager Barracks
  - Illager Barracks are a Bigger structure spawning in Plains biomes rarely
  - Illager Barracks hold mainly chests with charts to illager, or illager aligned structures
  - It prespawns illagers, meaning the illagers do not prespawn. However, prepare for unforeseen consequences
 - Updated Bunkers
  - Bunkers no longer can generate under sea level, this should help with ugly floating water worms inside the bunker
  - Bunkers now have a new starting piece, placing itself always underground a few blocks to ensure it starts buried to prevent stone brick plateaus
  - A new Structure Set has been added to ensure there is a Bunker above a stronghold, however depending on terrain, a bunker can fail to spawn
  - Bunkers Graves got removed
  - Bunkers got a new loottable mimicking the Stronghold Loottable, this means no more accidental eye trim
- Updated Bridge Remnant
  - Bridge remnant can now spawn in a small and big size, the big size is the same as before
  - Bridge remnants can now spawn in different lenghs at random.
- Shrine towers are more common
- Updated Enchantments:
  - Waxed Wings has been fixed to be mutex with Unbreaking
  - Wither Coating has been nerfed to deal only 6 total damage instead of 10, or only 3 hearts of damage instead of 5
- Updated some advancement names and fixed some not triggering correctly
- Updated Nametags to be replaced by Lapis Lazuli in ALL Loottables that had them
- Updated Saddles to be replaced by Leather in ALL Loottables that had them
- Updated Feature Placement in DnT structures due to the Random Patch changes. this may have caused some unforseen changes or not be 1:1 the same as before
